rules.title: Berkeley Rent Stabilization Ordinance: rent control coverage
rules.requirement: Rent control applies only to 'Fully Covered' units: most units in multifamily properties built before 1980, single-family homes with current tenancies that began before 1996, and rooming houses (single-family homes with five or more rooms rented individually under separate leases). New construction (certificate of occupancy after June 1980), single-family tenancies beginning on or after Jan 1, 1996, most condominiums and certain subsidized units are only partially covered and have no rent control. Listed exempt unit types are outside the ordinance entirely.

unverifiable_exemptions: Government subsidy status (Section 202, Section 811, or Rental Supplement/Section 8 Loan Management Set Aside/Project-based Section 8 in a project with a HUD-insured or HUD-held mortgage)
Golden duplex: owner-occupied on December 31, 1979 and currently owner-occupied
Owner shares kitchen or bath with tenant and lived on the property when the tenancy started
ADU property with an owner-occupied unit and tenancy started after Nov 7, 2018
coverage.summary: Rent control covers multifamily buildings built before 1980, single-family homes with tenancies that began before 1996, and rooming houses; newer buildings, later single-family tenancies and most condos are not covered.
coverage.construction_date_basis: Built before 1980 for multifamily; certificate of occupancy after June 1980 for new construction (not covered)
coverage.owner_conditions: Golden duplex and shared kitchen/bath owner-occupied units are exempt.
coverage.other_conditions: Single-family homes covered only if the current tenancy began before 1996. Most condominiums are not covered.

rules.exemptions: Partially covered (no rent control): new construction with certificate of occupancy after June 1980; single-family tenancies beginning on or after Jan 1, 1996; most condominiums; Section 202/811 units; certain HUD-insured subsidized projects. Exempt: Golden Duplex; owner shares kitchen/bath; ADU property tenancies started after Nov 7, 2018 with an owner-occupied unit; university rental units; nonprofit cooperatives.
rules.citation: Berkeley Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance
rules.quoted_span: Most units in multifamily properties built before 1980** Fully Covered Yes Yes Yes Yes
rules.review_note: The document is a coverage guide that gives no section numbers, cap formula or dates. The table says 'built before 1980' for fully covered units and 'Certificate of Occupancy after June 1980' for partial coverage, which leaves an unaddressed gap (January to June 1980). The municipal code chapter in the aliases comes from the citation style examples, not from the document.
rules.source_notes: Official Rent Board guide that describes itself as 'intended as a guide'.

rules.title: Berkeley Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance: coverage
rules.requirement: Just cause for eviction applies to both fully and partially covered units, which includes pre-1980 multifamily units, single-family homes, rooming houses, new construction, most condominiums and certain subsidized units. Exempt unit types (Golden Duplex, owner sharing kitchen/bath, ADU-property tenancies started after Nov 7, 2018 with an owner-occupied unit, university units, nonprofit cooperatives) are not covered.

unverifiable_exemptions: Golden duplex: owner-occupied on December 31, 1979 and currently owner-occupied
Owner shares kitchen or bath with tenant and lived on the property when the tenancy started
ADU property with an owner-occupied unit and tenancy started after Nov 7, 2018
coverage.summary: Covers all unit types in the table except the exempt categories, regardless of construction date or single-family tenancy start date.
coverage.owner_conditions: Exempt: Golden Duplex with owner living in one unit; owner who shares kitchen or bath with tenant and lived on the property when the tenancy started; ADU property with an owner-occupied unit (tenancies after Nov 7, 2018).
coverage.other_conditions: University rental units and nonprofit cooperatives are exempt.

rules.exemptions: Exempt: Golden Duplex; owner shares kitchen/bath; ADU property tenancies started after Nov 7, 2018 with an owner-occupied unit; university rental units such as dormitories; nonprofit cooperative.
rules.citation: Berkeley Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance
citation_aliases: Berkeley Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance
rules.quoted_span: Most condominiums** Partially Covered Yes No Yes Yes
rules.review_note: The document lists coverage only, with no allowed causes, notice requirements or relocation amounts. The municipal code chapter in the aliases comes from the citation style examples, not from the document.
rules.source_notes: Official Rent Board guide. Partially covered units are marked 'Yes' in the Just Cause for Eviction column.

result.doc_summary: Berkeley Rent Board guide in table form showing which unit types are fully covered, partially covered or exempt under the Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance. For each type it shows whether registration, rent control, just cause for eviction and security deposit interest apply. Rent control reaches only fully covered units, while just cause and deposit interest reach both fully and partially covered units. The guide gives no rates, dates or section numbers.
